# Supplementary Figure 8 — MurJ

Inward-open vs outward-facing states of the lipid-II flippase MurJ: **6NC7** (inward-open)
vs **6NC9** (outward-facing), scored by Cα-RMSD to each reference (x = `6nc7_rmsd`,
y = `6nc9_rmsd`).

**Method (divide-and-conquer → occurrence voting).** Clade-based divide-and-conquer spreads
the MSA; occurrence voting enriches each state; the top-16 sequences per state are
re-predicted (5 models × 8 seeds = 40 structures), against a 16-random control.

**Figure** = `four_panel_rmsd_scatter.png`, generated by
`results_updated/MurJ/run2/divide_and_conquer/random_pred/plot_four_panel_rmsd.py`. Sources
copied (read-only) from `results_updated/MurJ/run2/`.

| Panel | Backing CSV (this folder) | Source | Rows |
|-------|---------------------------|--------|------|
| Divide & Conquer | `panel1_divide_and_conquer_structure_analysis.csv` | `divide_and_conquer/plot_rmsd_tmp/structure_analysis_results_rmsd.csv` | 4,470 |
| Inward-open (6NC7) top-16 | `panel2_6nc7_inward_open_top16.csv` | `occurrence_voting_6nc7_rmsd/results/prediction/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |
| Outward-facing (6NC9) top-16 | `panel3_6nc9_outward_facing_top16.csv` | `occurrence_voting_6nc9_rmsd/results/prediction/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |
| Random-16 control | `panel4_random16_control.csv` | `divide_and_conquer/random_pred/random16_pred/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |

Uses the RMSD occurrence-voting runs (`occurrence_voting_6nc7_rmsd`, `_6nc9_rmsd`).
